retirement_age.notes: Two-track system phased in since 2013. In 2026 the ordinary age is 66 years 10 months, or 65 with at least 38 years 3 months of contributions. From 2027 it becomes 67, or 65 with at least 38 years 6 months of contributions. The value 67 is the age reached once the transition completes.
